title: Billboard Top 100
hook: The data this week comes from Data.World by way of Sean Miller, Billboard.com and Spotify. The Billboard Hot 100 is the music industry standard record chart in the United States for songs, published weekly by Billboard magazine. Chart rankings are based on sales (physical and digital), radio play, and online streaming in the United States. Drake rewrites the record for the most entries ever on the Billboard Hot 100, as he lands his 208th career title on the latest list, dated March 21 ThePudding has a neat interactive experience by year with audio! Some exploratory graphs by Azhad Syed.
